       sdk:hasProcessCapability ?processCap ;

  FILTER(
    LCASE(?bizStatLabel) = "woman-owned" ||
    LCASE(?bizStatLabel) = "veteran-owned" ||
    LCASE(?bizStatLabel) = "small disadvantaged business"
  )

  # Public web address
  ?webAddr iof-scro:hasTextValue ?webAddrText .
  FILTER(REGEX(?webAddrText,"^http(s)?://"))

  # NAICS
  ?naics sdk:hasNAICSCodeValue ?naicsCode ;
         sdk:hasNAICSTextValue ?naicsName .
}

SELECT ?manufacturer_name ?city_label ?state_label (COUNT(DISTINCT ?proc_cap) AS ?process_count) ?naics_text
WHERE {
  # Manufacturer base
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                rdfs:label ?manufacturer_name ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
                sdk:hasProcessCapability ?proc_cap ;
                sdk:hasPrimaryNAICSClassifier ?naics .

  # Manufacturer is headquartered in the Midwest (region mapping required, so match state in Midwest)
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?state_label .
  FILTER(?state_label IN (
    "Illinois", "Indiana", "Iowa", "Kansas", "Michigan", "Minnesota",
    "Missouri", "Nebraska", "North Dakota", "Ohio", "South Dakota", "Wisconsin"
  ))

  # For city label

  # Web address required (i.e., there must be a postal address with a value)
  ?site sdk:hasPostalAddress ?address .
  ?address iof-scro:hasTextValue ?webaddr .
  FILTER(STRLEN(STR(?webaddr)) > 0)

  # Exclude woman-owned
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
    ?manufacturer sdk:hasSpecialBusinessStatusClassifier ?status .
    ?status rdfs:label ?status_label .
    FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?status_label), "woman"))
  }

  # Process requirements -- anodizing on aluminum OR anodizing on titanium
  {
    ?manufacturer sdk:hasProcessCapability ?proc1 .
    ?proc1 rdfs:label ?proc1_label .
    FILTER(
      LCASE(?proc1_label) = "anodizing on aluminum"
      ||
      LCASE(?proc1_label) = "anodizing on titanium"
    )
  }

  # Offer passivation OR powder coating

    ?manufacturer sdk:hasProcessCapability ?proc2 .
    ?proc2 rdfs:label ?proc2_label .
    FILTER(
      LCASE(?proc2_label) = "passivation"
      ||
      LCASE(?proc2_label) = "powder coating"
    )
  }

  # Supplies to both aerospace and military industries
  ?manufacturer sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?industry1 .
  ?manufacturer sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?industry2 .
  ?industry1 rdfs:label ?industry1_label .
  ?industry2 rdfs:label ?industry2_label .
  FILTER(
    (CONTAINS(LCASE(?industry1_label), "aerospace") && CONTAINS(LCASE(?industry2_label), "military"))
    || (CONTAINS(LCASE(?industry2_label), "aerospace") && CONTAINS(LCASE(?industry1_label), "military"))
  )

  # NAICS text
  ?naics sdk:hasNAICSTextValue ?naics_text .
}
GROUP BY ?manufacturer ?manufacturer_name ?city_label ?state_label ?naics_text
ORDER BY DESC(?process_count)

user_query: For each state, return the top 3 manufacturers by employees.
Bucket manufacturers into Small (?50), Medium (51250), Large (>250) by employees and count companies per bucket.
sparql_query:
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?bucket (COUNT(DISTINCT ?company) AS ?companyCount)
WHERE {
  ?company a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
           sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?numStr .
  BIND(xsd:integer(REPLACE(str(?numStr), ",", "")) AS ?employees)
  BIND(
    IF(?employees <= 50,
       "Small: <=50",
       IF(?employees <= 250,
          "Medium: 51-250",
          "Large: >250"
       )
    ) AS ?bucket
  )
  BIND(
    IF(?employees <= 50, 1, IF(?employees <= 250, 2, 3))
    AS ?rank
  )
}
GROUP BY ?bucket ?rank
ORDER BY ?rank

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>

SELECT ?naicsCode (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?m a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
     sdk:hasPrimaryNAICSClassifier ?naicsInst .
  ?naicsInst sdk:hasNAICSCodeValue ?naicsCode .
}
GROUP BY ?naicsCode
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)
LIMIT 1

Which manufacturers have no business description-or only a blank one?

Within each industry, which manufacturers have above-average employee counts?
For each state, what's the average employee count among manufacturers that make any product with a digit in the name?
sparql_query:
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (AVG(?employees) AS ?avgEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?empLit ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER EXISTS {
    ?org sdk:manufactures ?prod .
    ?prod rdfs:label ?prodLabel .
    FILTER(REGEX(STR(?prodLabel), "\\d"))
  }
  BIND(xsd:integer(REPLACE(STR(?empLit), ",", "")) AS ?employees)
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

user_query: For each state, give two numbers: total process capabilities and total material capabilities.
For each primary NAICS code, show how many manufacturers use it, how many products those manufacturers make in total, and the average employee count.
Return company names in English only (or all if no language tags).
Which manufacturers have "Company" in either their name or their description?
Which manufacturers make products named exactly "Tube Bending" or "Punching"?
Who in California has at least 20 employees and at least one process capability whose name ends with "ing"?
sparql_query:
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?orgLabel
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       rdfs:label ?orgLabel ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?num ;
       sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap rdfs:label ?capLabel .
  FILTER(REGEX(?capLabel, "ing$", "i"))
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)) = "california")
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?num), ",", "") AS ?numClean)
  BIND(xsd:integer(?numClean) AS ?numInt)
  FILTER(?numInt >= 20)
}

user_query: Who supplies to both Renewable Energy and Utilities and also holds ISO 9001?
sparql_query:
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?orgLabel
WHERE {
  ?org sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?indRE .
  ?indRE a sdk:RenewableEnergyIndustry .
  ?org sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?indUtil .
  ?indUtil a sdk:UtilitiesIndustry .
  ?org sdk:hasCertificate ?cert .
  ?cert a sdk:ISO9001 .
  OPTIONAL { ?org rdfs:label ?orgLabel . }
}
